    weight = 0.0

        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source

            and destination_pod.current_node >= 0
            and source_pod.current_node != destination_pod.current_node
        )
        if movable_edge:
            source_node = state.nodes[source_pod.current_node]
            target_node = state.nodes[destination_pod.current_node]
            latency = source_node.latency_to_ms[destination_pod.current_node]
            peak_dest = node_peak_after(target_node, source_pod)
            peak_src = node_peak_after(source_node, destination_pod)
            best_peak = 2.0
            best_target = -1
            best_pod = -1
            if not source_pod.stateful and not source_pod.has_pdb and latency > 10.0:
                if peak_dest < best_peak:
                    best_peak = peak_dest
                    best_target = destination_pod.current_node
                    best_pod = source_pod.id
            if not destination_pod.stateful and not destination_pod.has_pdb and latency > 10.0:
                if peak_src < best_peak:
                    best_peak = peak_src
                    best_target = source_pod.current_node
                    best_pod = destination_pod.id
            if best_pod >= 0 and best_peak < 0.70:
                target = state.nodes[best_target]
                if not target.suspended:
                    out.append(move_pod(best_pod, best_target))
                    moved = moved + 1
    return out
